objective: One healthcare team. One photography language.

crop.framing: head and upper torso; approximately mid-chest

capture.bodyAngle: 10-20 degrees off camera; face toward lens
capture.lighting: large diffused key 30-45 degrees, slightly above eye level; gentle fill
capture.background: consistent warm off-white, stone or pale warm grey clinic-neutral background

postProduction.colour: natural skin tones, neutral white balance, restrained saturation, subtle contrast
postProduction.sharpness: eyes are the sharpest point; modest output sharpening

authenticityPriority: generic internal AI reference only; never presented as a named practitioner
cardRule: Photography adapts to the approved card. Card dimensions and website architecture do not change.
professionalPhotographyDay: capture neutral and natural warm-smile variants
retain verified file naming by practitioner
